scores.tell: Red background is slightly dull and the pale blue/white cup is low-chroma, but the hue roles are clear and the palette is clean.
Blue background with a navy hero, and yellow, cyan and red as small accents. This is like the real light card, but the cool-on-cool hero is a little dark and muted.
The magenta wall is very loud and has no neutral rest. The pink and orange wood floor and posts all sit in one warm band, so the gate has no hue contrast against the floor.
Blue, white and grey hue families are all cool and low-chroma. The plane has little accent color, and the sky and clouds have a slightly airbrushed color gradient.
Green wall, red booth and yellow accents give strong hue roles. The booth's teal glass is a little muted.
Natural green scene with a grey-lilac stone hero that is too pale and low-chroma. Hero and background are both cool, with no accent, and the whole card is a wide landscape of one green.
The saddle and orange-brown wood on cyan match the real saddle's palette. The leather is a bit more orange and saturated, and the stirrups are a bit orange.
Navy beam on a cyan-blue background with yellow and red accents. The yellow clamps are loud, and the navy has a purple cast.
Yellow duck on green rays with a sand floor and red and blue accents. It uses many hue families and the sand is very warm, but each is natural and well separated.
Orange background with a teal hero, a complementary pairing. The red and yellow buttons add many hue families. The pale peach floor is flat and a bit washed out.
